source_requirement: 将用户自然语言业务描述转化为符合 BPMN 2.0 标准的工作流 XML，含泳道、消息流、自动布局与视觉美化，可在 bpmn.io 或 Camunda 中直接打开。

self_critique_findings.finding: 11 skills have ≤ 1 reasoning step and are deterministic transforms or lookup operations — they are MCP Tools, not Skills.
Both are single-pass analytical operations. ambiguity-detector performs a checklist on intent+entities (no more complex than a tool-level check). parallel-optimizer performs graph analysis.
Primary trigger for all six is 'currently in layer X, previous output is ready'. They cannot be triggered by a user in fresh context without the prior pipeline stages.

capabilities.name: converting-business-to-bpmn
capabilities.description: End-to-end orchestration skill: takes a natural language business description and produces a complete BPMN 2.0 XML file. Internally orchestrates 13 tools across 5 pipeline layers.
capabilities.output: .bpmn file (BPMN 2.0 XML), validation summary, coverage score
capabilities.classification_rationale: The central independently-triggerable skill for the entire BPMN conversion pipeline. User asks 'generate BPMN from this description' → this skill orchestrates everything.

capabilities.name: decomposing-business-process
capabilities.description: Independently useful planning skill: takes a business description and produces a structured process plan (ordered steps, BPMN hints, dependency DAG, parallel groups) without going all the way to BPMN XML. Useful when users want a process breakdown for review, estimation, or partial generation.
capabilities.output: Structured process plan: ordered steps, dependency DAG, parallel groups, BPMN element hints
capabilities.classification_rationale: Users frequently ask 'break this process into steps' without needing BPMN XML. This skill handles the planning phase independently, incorporating template matching, decomposition, dependency resolution, and parallel optimization as internal tool calls.

capabilities.name: validating-bpmn-compliance
capabilities.description: Independently useful validation skill: takes a BPMN 2.0 XML file and validates structural compliance (schema, required elements) plus logical consistency (no deadlocks, orphans, broken flows). Independently triggerable on any existing BPMN file.
capabilities.input: BPMN 2.0 XML string; optional: original_intent + original_entities for coverage check
capabilities.output: Validation report: valid (boolean), errors[], warnings[], optional coverage_score
capabilities.classification_rationale: Users regularly need to validate existing BPMN files independently of generation. 12+ checks with conditional outputs and error reporting qualify as multi-step reasoning. Also absorbs intent-coverage-evaluator as an optional check.

capabilities.name: parse-business-intent
capabilities.description: Parses NL description into structured intent JSON: business_type, goal, constraints, scope.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Deterministic NLP transform with 5 sequential steps, no branching or context accumulation. Single atomic operation. Trigger is 'currently at pipeline step 1' — not independently triggerable in fresh context.

capabilities.name: extract-process-entities
capabilities.description: Extracts roles, systems, data objects, and triggers from description + intent.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Deterministic NLP extraction, 5 sequential steps, no reasoning branches. Trigger is 'at pipeline step 2 with intent output ready'.

capabilities.name: detect-description-ambiguity
capabilities.description: Checks intent + entities for ambiguities, outputs clarification questions.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Checklist-style validation (4 checks → flag/pass). Self-Critique Check B: functionally a validation tool similar to a linter. No independent trigger that doesn't require prior pipeline outputs.

capabilities.name: match-bpmn-template
capabilities.description: Compares structured intent against BPMN template library, returns top-3 candidates with similarity scores.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Single lookup + scoring operation. Deterministic given a template library.

capabilities.name: decompose-process-steps
capabilities.description: Decomposes business goal + entities into ordered steps with BPMN element hints.
capabilities.note: The independently-triggerable SKILL 'decomposing-business-process' (cap-02) orchestrates this tool alongside others. This tool itself is one step in that orchestration.
capabilities.classification_rationale: While step decomposition requires LLM reasoning, within the new architecture this is a single focused tool call within the 'decomposing-business-process' skill. The skill wraps it with intent parsing, template matching, and dependency resolution.

capabilities.name: resolve-step-dependencies
capabilities.description: Computes dependency relationships from step list, outputs a DAG.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Algorithmic graph construction from step.preconditions list. Deterministic.

capabilities.name: identify-parallel-steps
capabilities.description: Analyzes DAG for parallelizable steps and annotates with parallel group IDs.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Graph traversal algorithm. No conversation context accumulation.

capabilities.name: map-steps-to-bpmn-elements
capabilities.description: Maps process steps + DAG to BPMN 2.0 element types (startEvent, task, gateway, etc.).
capabilities.classification_rationale: Decision table lookup. Trigger is 'at modeling layer with steps and DAG ready'.

capabilities.name: classify-bpmn-task-types
capabilities.description: Determines task subtypes (userTask/serviceTask/scriptTask) for each task element.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Classification table. Requires prior element mapping output.

capabilities.name: assemble-bpmn-model
capabilities.description: Assembles classified elements + participant assignments into a complete BPMN ProcessModel object.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Construction step — combines prior pipeline outputs into a model object. No independent trigger.

capabilities.name: assign-bpmn-participants
capabilities.description: Groups elements into pools and lanes based on actor/system assignments.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Role-to-lane assignment logic. Requires prior element classification.

capabilities.name: serialize-bpmn-xml
capabilities.description: Serializes ProcessModel + participants + lanes + message_flows into BPMN 2.0 XML string.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Deterministic template-filling / serialization. No reasoning required.

capabilities.name: optimize-bpmn-layout
capabilities.description: Applies orthogonal layout, color styling, and label deconfliction to BPMN XML's BPMNDI section.
capabilities.classification_rationale: Algorithmic layout computation. While multi-phase, all three phases (layout, style, labels) are deterministic algorithms with no reasoning or branching.
